<color=#990000>所有罪人陣亡</color>。
請選擇後續操作。

於10-4關卡，即使在戰鬥中使用接關功能，
最終通關時仍會記錄為EX通關。

但使用接關功能後，<color=#990000>未經重試、戰敗或放棄而贏得戰鬥並保存了進度</color>時，
<color=#990000>即使之後中途放棄10-4關卡，也不會返還接關時所消耗的道具。</color>
另外，已消耗的狂氣亦無法進行退款。
目前所持有的罪孽碎片數。
目前所遊玩的章節為<color=#3246AB>[{0}章 {1}]</color>。

◆ Main Story Canto 10 can be played without clearing previous story chapters. ◆ Canto 10 contains spoilers up to Intervallo VII-2. ◆ If you have not cleared the previous chapter by the time you have cleared Canto 10, various content that requires Main Story progression (Mirror Dungeon, Refraction Railway, Luxcavation, Reflectrial, etc.) will not be unlocked until each respective prerequisite is cleared. ◆ For any future content that requires clearing Canto 10 as the prerequisite, please clear both Canto 10 and Stage 9.5-26 to unlock. ◆ During Canto 10, Meursault will have access to certain Support Identities and E.G.O (at Uptie/Threadspinning Tier 4). ◆ During Canto 10, all allied Identities, including Meursault, will be guaranteed at least Uptie 3 (E.G.O Threadspinning Tier will not be affected).
